items.title: Upgrade wave: faster home News + Podcast panels
items.summary: Home news no longer waits on idle or cold aggregator feeds. Platform upgrades paint first; tech intel loads in the background with a short timeout so the panel stays snappy.

items.title: Upgrade: one Portals void bar across every page
items.summary: Category-dropdown nav clutter is gone. Every route now uses the start-page Portals button with neon MasterNoder tema — same catalog, cleaner chrome.

items.title: Upgrade: Star Map Ideas + loading ring cleanup
items.summary: Season 3 Ideas board is live (constellations, warp pulse, chronoscout). The left-edge spinner that looked like a progress ring is replaced with plain status text.

items.title: New podcast episode — November upgrade briefing
items.summary: Discuss Portals void, frontpage cleanup, Star Map Ideas, and MN2 comment rewards on Podcast News & Changes. New episode drop: Upgrade Briefing Nov 13.

items.title: Frontpage cleanup — shared Portals bar, no Agent void
items.summary: The start-page Portals button is now the site-wide nav. Dead Agent void, Live surface patch cards, and the embedded Game hub collector strip are gone from the home page. News and Podcast sit side by side.

items.title: Star Map 25 — Ideas board: constellations, warp pulse, chronoscout
items.summary: A new Ideas tab on Star Map 25 tracks constellation arcs, warp-pulse windows, alliance scans, and 4D chronoscout runs. Open /starmap25/?tab=ideas to pin concepts while you investigate systems.

items.title: Podcast portal refresh — home strip + MN2 comment hooks
items.summary: Podcast portal lines are updated across home, news, and Star Map. Comment on News & Changes for MN2 listen rewards; the home page now deep-links into news, episodes, social, and sound check.

items.title: Portal cleanup: wallets and staking pages are live
items.summary: Wallets, staking leaderboard, and staking teams now have first-class pages in the main portal with versioned uWSGI page serving instead of missing-page fallbacks.
